description.value:
You have picked up the fundamentals of several lightsaber combat forms. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You learn one new lightsaber form. If you already knew at least one form before taking this feat, you instead learn three new forms; if you already knew at least three, you instead learn seven new forms; and if you already knew at least ten, you learn every form you don't yet know.
